annotations.title: Settle an effect whose outcome was unknown

description: Use ONLY after you have checked the third-party system and now know what really happened to an effect that was left "indeterminate". Record "succeeded" if the action did occur, "failed" if it did not, or "cancelled" to abandon it. Include how you verified it in `evidence`. Never guess: resolving incorrectly is exactly the duplicate or lost action this service exists to prevent.

evidence.description: How you verified the real outcome. Stored in the audit trail.
